leads.title: At 80, a Lakshadweep nurse is a global top-10 finalist for the Aster Guardians Award, after 53 years of nursing
leads.summary: An 80-year-old nurse from Lakshadweep, Hindumbi Kaurom Kakkada, is a finalist for the Aster Guardians Award after five decades of service.

leads.title: Her home was washed away in the Assam floods. Days later, a 17-year-old won national gold in karate
leads.summary: Janmoni Konwar lost her home to floods, then won gold at nationals days later.

leads.title: Laws against ageism are now in 57.7% of countries, up from 44.5%
leads.summary: More countries are enacting laws against ageism and strengthening elderly care; anti-age-discrimination legislation rose from 44.5% to 57.7% of nations.

leads.title: Child drowning deaths worldwide fell from 30 to 7.4 per 100,000 since 1980
leads.summary: Drowning mortality among children under five dropped from 30 per 100,000 in 1980 to 7.4 per 100,000 by 2023.
